specificCoverage: All Projects Harbor and Beacon detail Plan reads carry each session's explicit project, then render a real first Plan-events page.
Relations use the public omitted/default first cursor, then an advancing child cursor and event sequence cursor on their second pages.
A successful and a failed post-result bridge hold cannot rewrite a later session or project selection.
Changed source reloads one cursor-free first page for Plan events, relation children and relation events while keeping all three disclosures open and retaining the reading anchor.

The independent All Projects live path holds a successful real sessions.get result; a Playwright wheel changes drawer scrollTop 347 to 707 and it remains 707 after release/re-render. This hold is before captureScrollAnchor, so it proves refresh preserves the latest reading position but does not by itself prove cancellation during an asynchronous nested loader. Held parent responses do not overwrite a new session or a Beacon project switch.

Search/Actions has one listbox with direct options; query replacement clears stale options/active descendant; tab clicks and Arrow/Home/End synchronize active class, aria-selected, aria-controls and visible tabpanel.

nestedLoaderR7Repair.sourceChange: Only app.js changed: drawer content receives overflow-anchor:none while installing the user-intent listener and while opening the drawer. No cursor, scope, stale-result, or test assertion was relaxed.
nestedLoaderR7Repair.result: 8/8 passed against the frozen r7 UI and real isolated helper with no page or console errors. This includes the retained nested-loader counterexample.
nestedLoaderR7Repair.nestedLoaderCounterexample: A source change triggered live capture/rebuild; after the real sessions.relations.get response was received it was held, then Playwright wheel input moved drawer scrollTop 347 to 707. On release the result remained scrollTop 707 and relation-summary relative position -388.953125. The exact first pages remained explicit-project and cursor-free/default, and session/project stale guards passed.
nestedLoaderR7Repair.mechanismBoundary: The source guard, event sequence and r7 overflow-anchor-only repair support an inference that Chromium native scroll anchoring caused the r6 jump. No scrollTop setter/event trace directly proves that conclusion or excludes every JavaScript restoration path.
nestedLoaderR7Repair.nativeBoundary: The local verification host is macOS/Safari 26.5.1 (WebKit 21624). WebKit announced CSS Scroll Anchoring/overflow-anchor support for Safari 27 beta, so this Chrome result neither establishes support nor passes the equivalent WKWebView behavior. Native verification remains required.
